title: ranunculus polyandrus
intro: Ranunculus polyandrus, commonly known as American water buttercup, is a perennial aquatic plant native to North America. The plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and antiviral properties. The health benefits of Ranunculus polyandrus are attributed to its therapeutic actions, including reducing fever, relieving pain, and soothing skin irritations. The bioactive constituents of the plant include alkaloids, glycosides, and saponins, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
